data.description:
## Story
37fc-6f8d-444d-44bf — As an agent filing a bug automatically, I want detected_by inferred from filing context

## testing_mode: UPDATE

## What to do
Modify `plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md` — find the bug-creation step.

In the block where a new bug ticket is created (search for `.claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug`), add the following BEFORE the ticket create call:

```bash
CHANNEL=$(DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=debug-everything bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/infer-detected-by.sh" 2>/dev/null || echo "other")
```

Then add `--tags "detected_by:$CHANNEL"` to the ticket create command.

If PLUGIN_SCRIPTS is not already set in that context, define it first:
```bash
PLUGIN_SCRIPTS="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso}/scripts"
```

## Verify
grep -n "DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=debug-everything" plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
grep -n "infer-detected-by.sh" plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
grep -n "detected_by" plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md

All three should return matches.

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3 (debug-everything portion): debug-everything bug-creation step sets DSO_FILING_CONTEXT before calling infer-detected-by.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] SKILL.md updated with DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=debug-everything wiring
- [ ] detected_by:$CHANNEL tag applied to newly created bug ticket
- [ ] grep verifications above all return matches
data.title: UPDATE: wire DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=debug-everything into debug-everything SKILL.md bug-creation step
